FIELD_RECIPES.//: Combining in the bag (V2, carried 10-1 with Cam's yes, 16 October; Cam: "Follow the economists suggestion of starting small with the hunters 3"). The first field recipes are the Hunter's living-off-the-land crafts (Part 4), which used to be one-off buttons; now one way in: Use one thing with another. use / on: the two things (either way round; "@knife" is any hunting knife, carried or held); act: the rule that makes it (landAct); pass: the "on" item goes to the rule as its item. One home per recipe (the team's condition): a field recipe is made only in the bag. Step 2 (16 October, the Economist's plan: arrows and bandages for every class, pages from quests and creatures only): a recipe is known by a Hunter with a knife (hunter: true) or by anyone who has read its PAGE (a scroll, read from the bag like a spell scroll); a recipe with needs (each make takes these, gives n) runs through fieldMake, not landAct -- at about two-thirds of a bench's xp (the Mathematician's condition).

list.name: Arrow shafts
list.about: Whittle twigs or an oak log into arrow shafts (birch goes to the fletching table).

list.name: Bone arrows
list.about: A shaft, a bone arrowhead and a feather.

list.name: Improvised arrows
list.about: A shaft with leaf litter for flights. Hunters with a knife know it; anyone can learn it from Ash's notes.

list.name: Bandages
list.about: Tear a cloth into strips and pack them with herbs: two bandages. Learnt from Beekeeper Nell's page.

list.//: I11 (2026-10-20, Cam: "make flint arrows from the bag as well, using a chisel on flint to shape to arrow heads ... Range level 3 will unlock it by default as a hunter"; other classes: a page). The fletching bench's flint recipes moved here -- one home per recipe.
list.name: Flint arrowheads
list.about: Knap flint into arrowheads with a chisel (it wears, a use a head). A Hunter knows how from Ranged 3; anyone can learn it from the knapper's page.

list.name: Flint arrows
list.about: A shaft, a flint arrowhead and a feather: a flint arrow, better than bone or twig. A Hunter knows how from Ranged 3; anyone can learn it from the knapper's page.

FIELD_ITEMS.//: What step 2 adds: the recipe pages (scrolls: read from the bag, the recipe is yours for good) and the bandage (a small heal, in a fight or out -- it costs your next attack, like food). Icon sheet 71.

FIELD_PAGES.//: Where pages turn up besides their quests (Ash's "Too many legs", Nell's "Stung"): carried by these creatures, one kill in `chance`, only while you don't know the recipe and have no copy. Rolled apart from the fight's own dice, so fights play out the same.
